Spacious 4-Bedroom Coastal Home with Sea Views & Income Potential in Perlemoenbaai

A Peaceful Coastal Lifestyle just moments from the Walker Bay shoreline and Duiwelsgat hiking Trail, situated on an elevated 502m² corner stand in the sought-after coastal suburb of Perlemoenbaai, this spacious and well-maintained facebrick home offers comfortable family living, generous entertainment areas and excellent versatility for extended family, guests or additional rental income.

A Peaceful Coastal Lifestyle just moments from the Walker Bay shoreline and Duiwelsgat hiking Trail, situated on an elevated 502m² corner stand in the sought-after coastal suburb of Perlemoenbaai, this spacious and well-maintained facebrick home offers comfortable family living, generous entertainment areas and excellent versatility for extended family, guests or additional rental income.

The main residence is conveniently arranged on one level, creating an easy and practical flow throughout the home. At its heart is a generous open-plan living and entertaining area, where the lounge, dining area and fitted kitchen come together to create a welcoming space for everyday family life and entertaining, the dining area, features an indoor built-in braai, and opens towards a sheltered covered balcony/veranda, providing an inviting setting for morning coffee, relaxed afternoons and gatherings.

The well-appointed kitchen offers generous preparation and cupboard space, a large breakfast counter with seating for approximately eight people, a gas stove, electric oven and extractor fan, together with a walk-in pantry with dedicated wine-storage space.

Three generously proportioned bedrooms are situated along the passage, all with built-in cupboards. The main bedroom includes extensive cupboard space, a ceiling fan and a full en-suite bathroom. The other two bedrooms share a second full bathroom.

Adding exceptional flexibility to the property is the privately positioned fourth bedroom, with a separate entrance and an en-suite bathroom and can be utilized as a storing facility.

There is a double automated garage, and additional parking. The paved rear garden provides practical outdoor space and additional parking, while the established low-maintenance garden complements the easy-care coastal lifestyle.

Constructed in durable facebrick, the home is well suited to the coastal environment and offers a combination of solid construction, practicality and low-maintenance appeal.

Property Features

• Erf size: 502m² with +/- 280m² under roof

• Elevated corner stand, one street away from the sea, +/- 150m to the Duiwelsgat hiking trail

• Beautiful sea, mountain and surrounding fynbos views

• Spacious open-plan lounge and dining area with indoor built-in braai

• Sheltered covered balcony/veranda

• Fully fitted kitchen - large breakfast counter seating approximately 8

• Gas stove, electric oven and extractor fan

• Walk-in pantry with wine-storage area

• 3 spacious bedrooms in the main residence

• Main bedroom with ample built-in cupboards and full en-suite bathroom

• Second full bathroom

• Separate fourth bedroom (flatlet) with private entrance and en-suite bathroom

• Excellent guest accommodation or potential rental opportunity

• Double automated garage & additional off-street parking

• Paved rear garden, low-maintenance garden

• Facebrick exterior, tiled roof, knotty pine ceilings, combination of laminated, tiled and carpeted flooring

• Linen cupboard

• Alarm system

• Burglar bars

• Security doors and gates

Perlemoenbaai offers the opportunity to enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle between the mountains and the sea, while remaining conveniently close to Gansbaai's shops, restaurants, schools and essential amenities. The surrounding area is renowned for its spectacular coastline, scenic walking routes, whale watching and outdoor lifestyle. Walker Bay is particularly well known for seasonal Southern Right Whale sightings, while nearby attractions include coastal hiking trails, Stanford's Cove, De Plaat and the marine-tourism attractions of Gansbaai.

Whether you're looking for a spacious permanent family home, a coastal retirement retreat, a holiday property or a home with the flexibility to accommodate guests or generate potential rental income, this property offers an appealing combination of space, location, views and versatility.

Contact u today to arrange your private viewing of this exceptional Perlemoenbaai home.
